items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Jack... was married at the time--her name was Addie and she was managing the band... I saw a bunch of cops dragging Jack out of his room... and they dragged Addie out too

ctx.x: If it was done somewhere, somebody's got it.

We weren't on the air too much. I can't recall--once I think we did an army base and I think that was broadcast, but I don't think it was ever put on the air. I just happened to think of something I haven't thought of in years. Jack, by reputation and in fact was a drinker, this man could consume cases and still walk straight, and he was married at the time--her name was Addie and she was managing the band and she was an aviatix too; she was quite a woman. She drank, she matched him bottle for bottle and we were…

covered with blood. What had happened was that they were drinking in their room, drinking and drinking and arguing and the arguing got into an all-out brawl and Addie broke a whiskey bottle across Jack's chops, right across his mouth. We didn't know how the hell--of course he wasn't going to show up for the show, they certainly were going to keep him in the hospital overnight at least. So we were talking about what to do, what to do and word came down, don't worry, just go straight ahead. So we were in the pit…
